summary: ovl/atc is the working record of an SAP ATC (ABAP Test Cockpit) S/4HANA-readiness custom-code remediation for ONGC Videsh (OVL), ECC to S/4; the source listings carry the banner 'System OCQ / 500 User SAP_ABAP 08.08.2026'. The repo holds four ATC exports: the 09/06/26 export with 10,165 findings on 1,403 objects (P1 3,306 / P2 960 / P3 5,899), an undated later export (export_atc_errors.xlsx) with 5,220 findings on 640 objects whose latest 'First Found On' is 03/08/26, a 132-row file atc_ovl_050826.xlsx that is a row-for-row subset of that later export, and ovl_ocq_syntax_error.xlsx with 994 'Prerequisites for the test' rows. The Assignment sheet of the 09/06/26 export allocates 1,413 object/type pairs to named developers; 'Arnav' holds 44 (all ENHO, all Status 'Done'). COPILOT_CONTEXT_HANDOFF.md section 5.6 and the August worklog describe the August stream as 847 findings on the consultant's assigned objects, worked 05-14/08/26 'family by family'; the 847 figure cannot be reproduced from the files in the repo. The deliverable is 51 corrected program includes (43 parent programs, 14 packages, all R3TR PROG; 105,851 lines), each stored three times (153 files). The August pass is identifiable by 205 marker blocks '*--- BEGIN/END OF CHANGE BY SAP_ABAP 08.08.2026 FOR ATC ---' spread over all 51 files; a line diff of the 38 files that have a pre-remediation snapshot shows 296 changed hunks, 833 added/changed lines and #EC pragma lines rising from 351 to 527. A further 172 SAP_ABAP marker blocks dated 05-16.06.2026 were already in the system download of 08/08/26 and are not part of the August pass. By content the 205 August blocks are 107 pragma-only, 65 commented-old-code-plus-replacement and 33 new/changed code without a commented original (16 blocks read a released CDS view, 18 rebuild a SELECT SINGLE as UP TO 1 ROWS, 34 swap J_1IMOVEND for LFA1, 4 insert a SORT). The AI assistant (Claude Code; a later handoff file targets GitHub Copilot) is evidenced by the /atc-fix skill, the 31-rule handover, the knowledge base written 'for a new Claude session', the rule auditor and its first-person audit report; the ABAP files themselves carry only the author tag SAP_ABAP. A machine rule audit of 23/08/26 reported 433 rule findings in 41 of the 51 objects, 46 of them in 18 objects 'expected to fail activation'; it is explicitly a candidate list (the tool does not compile) and none of the 46 sites has been changed since - re-running the auditor on 19/11/26 returns the identical 433. The audit attributes to the remediation +13 SELECT...ENDSELECT loops, +2 unguarded FOR ALL ENTRIES and one duplicate inline declaration; an independent check shows that all 21 activation-candidate statements located in files with a snapshot already exist verbatim in the pre-remediation snapshot, and the other 25 sit in files without a snapshot. No file in the repo records that any of the 51 corrected programs was imported, activated, syntax-checked on the target system or re-run through ATC; the handover states closure 'is proven only by re-running ATC in the system' and a later issue log notes that the 26/08 system download of ZFI_JV_TB did not contain the 08.08.2026 ATC change. The only code change after delivery is the 24/08/26 fix of a misspelled FI_DOCUMENT_CHANGE parameter in ZFI_CHNG_PYBLCK after a runtime dump; the misspelling predates the August pass and the same active text is still present in 7 other corrected files. Open items include a 26-row manual-review list with an empty Decision column, five unanswered policy questions, parked BP* and DML findings and objects whose source was never exported.
